output.explanation:
The central tree retains the seed's conceptual coverage while shrinking from 137 to 93 lines (32.1%) and from 10033 to 6438 characters (35.8%). Five peripheral trees expand meaningful central concepts, mixing modular structure [M], calls [C], ownership [O], and data prerequisites [D]. Positions use measured text dimensions, with at least 18 columns between diagram columns and seven rows between vertically adjacent peripherals. All edge references are 1-based raw lines.

Source-grounded corrections and qualifications: (1) Projection maps live per instance. apiProjection.ts:10 states an intention to share one backend instance, but sessionService.ts:70 and liveCanvasService.ts:36 independently default to new instances; supplied construction wiring does not establish sharing. (2) Diagram-context status depends on binding and source fingerprint, while materialization supplies the payload separately (sessionService.ts:241-249). Thus the seed overstates materialized backing data as a prerequisite for status. (3) The checkpoint save flow applies without nodeId; saving one diagram instead isolates a versioned snapshot, rebases metadata and saves without canvas edges (sessionService.ts:672-714). (4) QuickJS context lifetime is one runtime invocation, including a fresh invocation during replay; retained retry state belongs to the session service. Pure-read request-cache release specifically requires a result with version and without transaction (sessionService.ts:186-188).

Peripheral additions absent from the seed include exact batch barriers and internal request prefixes (sessionService.ts:351-382), transport IDs versus mutation request IDs (canvasSessionBridge.ts:29-41; useAgentCanvasBridge.ts:43-50), copy capability negotiation and whole-diagram selection rules (liveCanvasService.ts:37-46,168-195), socket feature flags and queue limits (liveCanvasRoutes.ts:57-92), anchor capacity and jump-target membership checks (apiProjection.ts:16-41; sessionService.ts:565-585), and retained diagram-context mutation payloads (sessionService.ts:251-260).

Only the point definition, embedded pinned sources and seed were used as evidence. Imported implementations, tool HTTP route dispatch, and application construction wiring are not supplied; their internal behavior and end-to-end guarantees remain unverified. In particular, the browser hook's transport-command cache does not itself prove mutation deduplication across newly allocated dispatch IDs.

diagrams.ascii:
Live Canvas Agent API
|-- [M] Modular structure: public boundaries and dependencies
|   |-- Agent-facing tool gateway
|   |   |-- MCP schema-defined tools over stdio -> HTTP tool requests
|   |   |-- Explicit target -> cached attachment; chat token -> captured target
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |       |-- Exposes call, callBound, submitDirect and argument resolution
|   |       |-- Keeps attachments, dispatch, exec replay and save sequencing internal
|   |       `-- Checks schemas, read-only access and attachment/proposal agreement
|   |-- Canvas operations and domain services
|   |   |-- CanvasSessionPort -> CanvasSessionBridge -> owning browser handler
|   |   |-- AgentExecRuntime -> QuickJsAgentRuntime -> validated host calls
|   |   |-- Semantic operations and current-state projections -> canvas domain
|   |   |-- DiagramEditService / DiagramBatchService -> generation and application
|   |   |-- ChangeSessionService -> proposal reads, changes, review and acceptance
|   |   `-- Diagram, repository and context services -> saved diagrams and evidence
|   |-- Live selection and context boundary
|   |   |-- WebSocket /api/mapping/live binds a publisher or reader role
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService exposes selection, context, copy, paste and upload
|   |   `-- HTTP selection reads use ETag; short context exposes epoch/version
|   `-- CanvasApiProjection: compact identity boundary
|       |-- Projects content anchors, nodes, edges, jumps and migrations
|       `-- Resolves incoming handles; grid output omits rendering internals
|-- [C] Call model: representative activations
|   |-- Tool request -> session service -> validate and route operation
|   |   |-- Bound call captures target and lazily attaches for scoped work
|   |   `-- exec -> runtime.run(code, invoke)
|   |       |-- Each API call validates its method and arguments
|   |       |-- Read -> live browser or proposal state -> projected result
|   |       `-- Mutation -> initial-version check -> resolve IDs -> semantic operation
|   |           |-- Immediate: apply one operation and advance tracked version
|   |           `-- Batched: queue provisional IDs; flush at barriers or completion
|   |-- Live apply -> bridge queue -> browser poll -> handle(command)
|   |   `-- Encode and POST reply -> settle waiting dispatch
|   |-- Proposal apply -> ChangeSessionService.apply
|   |   `-- Attachment must match changeSessionId; save cannot publish proposals
|   |-- Ambiguous exec outcome -> retry identical requestId and arguments
|   |   |-- Changed signatures fail; completed API outcomes replay
|   |   `-- Unacknowledged work retains operation IDs, version and request identity
|   |-- Prompt-driven edit/create/extend -> resolve target/context -> start run
|   |   |-- Status/cancel routes to the service retaining that run
|   |   `-- Application callbacks dispatch revision, creation or batch commands
|   |-- Save live document -> serialize -> checkpoint -> publish -> notify browser
|   |   `-- Save with nodeId instead isolates one diagram from a versioned snapshot
|   `-- Live socket events
|       |-- Publisher update -> validate/reconstruct selection -> notify readers
|       |-- Reader attach -> pin workspace/document/epoch -> initial snapshot
|       |-- context.get -> load context -> recheck identity -> project
|       `-- copy/paste -> owning publisher -> validate reply -> settle request
|-- [O] Ownership: retained state and resource lifetimes
|   |-- Browser workspace executes live commands
|   |   |-- Hook owns ephemeral canvasId, poll loop and 200 cached mutation replies
|   |   `-- pagehide unregisters; effect cleanup also aborts polling and retries
|   |-- CanvasSessionBridge owns registrations, queues, wakeups and pending promises
|   |   |-- Poll waits up to 15s; dispatch waits up to 25s
|   |   `-- Stale registration, unregister or disposal retires pending work
|   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService owns attachment and request/replay maps
|   |   |-- Transport ambiguity releases request promise for retry
|   |   |-- Successful exec clears replay; versioned pure reads release request cache
|   |   `-- Latest settled save removes its per-document promise chain
|   |-- QuickJS context belongs to one exec invocation
|   |   |-- Memory/stack, API-call, payload and execution-interrupt limits
|   |   `-- finally disposes context on success or failure
|   |-- LiveCanvasService owns publisher mirrors and pinned reader bindings
|   |   |-- Close/replacement/disconnect invalidates readers and pending copy/paste
|   |   `-- Copy/paste receipts persist in memory; each history caps at 2000
|   |-- CanvasApiProjection retains full-ID/handle maps without reassignment
|   |   `-- Lifetime is per instance; unknown compact handles require rereading
|   `-- Socket transport owns handshake, heartbeat and outbound queue bounds
|       |-- Slow readers reconnect for a snapshot; deltas are not silently dropped
|       `-- Server cleanup removes upgrade listener and terminates sockets
`-- [D] Data dependency: prerequisites for computed results
    |-- Projected canvas nodes and edges
    |   |-- Live/proposal document + canvas state + version + available bounds
    |   `-- Full content anchors + retained projection maps
    |-- Valid exec node/edge mutation
    |   |-- Matching attachment/proposal + expectedVersion = initial version
    |   `-- Arguments + resolved full IDs; source mappings also need content hash
    |-- Recoverable mutation result
    |   |-- Scoped requestId + exact signature + frozen operation/version/receipt
    |   `-- Acknowledgement supplies committed version; timeout does not
    |-- Current bound selection
    |   |-- Publisher snapshot + reader's pinned workspace/document/epoch
    |   `-- Delta needs prior regions and matching baseSequence; stale updates ignored
    |-- Live context response
    |   |-- Published selection readiness + injected document-context loader
    |   `-- Publisher/epoch stable across load; reader binding rechecked after await
    |-- Confirmed paste result
    |   |-- Bound identity + normalized ASCII + position + version + generated nodeId
    |   `-- Successful reply matches retained nodeId and expectedVersion + 1
    `-- Diagram-bound context status
        |-- No binding -> absent; source fingerprint match -> ready; mismatch -> stale
        `-- Materialization supplies context payload separately from status

Exec: validated calls and recoverable outcomes
|-- [C/D] Start or resume a request
|   |-- Key = [changeSessionId, sessionId, requestId]; signature = JSON input
|   |-- New attached run reads identity/snapshot and captures initial version
|   `-- API step signature = method + args; changed replay -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|-- [C] Translate calls into domain work
|   |-- Read-only mode allows an explicit set of read/list/attach methods
|   |-- Resolve aliases, parse method schema, decode compact anchors
|   |-- Node/edge writes require expectedVersion = initial version
|   |-- Immediate apply advances version and discards cached nodes/edges
|   `-- Batched writes return status=queued with provisional object IDs
|       |-- Flush before canvas.* and node/edge reads
|       |-- Also flush before nodes.setSourceMappings and nodes.setJumps
|       `-- Completion flushes; each batch pins indices and expectedVersion
|-- [O/D] Preserve uncertain work
|   |-- Step closure retains operation identity; outcome records value/error
|   |-- SHA-256 of request key forms internal step/batch request prefix
|   |-- Timeout / reply-too-large / reply-rejected leave work retryable
|   |-- Retry reruns script; completed API outcomes replay, uncertain work resends
|   |-- Even a script-caught timeout cannot report an unfinished step as complete
|   `-- Success or non-transport failure removes execRuns entry
|-- [C] Document creation is a separate path
|   |-- createDocument/copyDocument require unbound exec; at most one per run
|   `-- copyDocument attaches directly after reply, before descriptor refresh
`-- [O/M] QuickJS context is fresh for each runtime.run invocation
    |-- Frozen canvas/nodes/edges methods call the host through JSON
    |-- 32 MiB memory; 512 KiB stack; at most 100 API calls
    |-- Each API result and final result limited to 4 MiB
    |-- Interrupt callback checks 30s deadline or more than 20000 interrupts
    `-- finally disposes context; retry state lives outside QuickJS

Live command bridge: browser activation and cleanup
|-- [C/O] Browser hook establishes identity
|   |-- Ephemeral canvasId from randomUUID; stableWorkspaceId loaded separately
|   |-- Register descriptor -> poll commands -> call latest handle(command)
|   |-- Cache mutation replies by transport command ID; evict oldest above 200
|   |-- Encode canvasReply -> POST reply with x-canvas-command-id
|   |   `-- HTTP rejection triggers a CANVAS_REPLY_REJECTED error reply
|   `-- Poll failure schedules re-registration/retry after 1s unless aborted
|-- [C/O] CanvasSessionBridge transports commands
|   |-- dispatch calls list(), which retires entries untouched for over 35s
|   |-- At most 100 pending dispatches; each gets a fresh transport UUID
|   |-- Queue command and wake poller; poll drains queue after at most 15s
|   |-- Matching canvasId + commandId reply settles promise and clears timer
|   `-- After 25s: reject and remove queued command; outcome may remain unknown
|-- [D] Transport ID and mutation request ID have different scopes
|   |-- A repeated dispatch allocates a new transport command ID
|   |-- Exec retains payload request IDs and operations across uncertain retries
|   `-- The hook's 200-entry cache alone cannot deduplicate a new dispatch ID
`-- [O] Cleanup paths
    |-- pagehide sends DELETE for the ephemeral instance
    |-- Poll effect cleanup aborts requests, clears retry timer and unregisters
    |-- Selection publication has a separate effect returning publisher cleanup
    `-- Bridge unregister/dispose wakes pollers and rejects pending dispatches

Live selection: pinned identity, deltas and reader work
|-- [M/O] Publisher and reader are separate socket roles
|   |-- Publisher must name a registered canvas; duplicate publisher rejected
|   |-- Owner object gates updates, removal and copy/paste replies
|   `-- Reader connectionId pins workspaceInstanceId + documentId + canvasEpoch
|-- [D/C] Reconstruct and validate selection
|   |-- Same-epoch sequence <= previous sequence is ignored
|   |-- Delta requires previous epoch and baseSequence to match
|   |-- Remove IDs, then upsert regions; missing diagramIds retains previous list
|   |-- Upserts/removals must be unique and disjoint
|   |-- Whole-diagram IDs are unique grid: IDs and exclude their regions
|   |-- Limits: 100 documents per publisher; 1000 diagrams and 1000 regions
|   |   `-- Sum of region text lengths <= 2000000
|   `-- New epoch invalidates bindings; same epoch notifies active readers
|-- [C/D] Context and HTTP reads
|   |-- context.get reads binding before and after awaiting context loader
|   |-- Loader must preserve publisher object and selected document epoch
|   |-- Selection ETag = quoted connectionId:sequence; match -> 304
|   `-- Short context GET is no-store and exposes epoch/version headers
|-- [C/O/D] Copy and paste retain receipts
|   |-- Key = workspace + document + epoch + requestId; signature includes input
|   |-- Changed signature -> REQUEST_ID_REUSED; receipts are never evicted
|   |-- Each history caps at 2000 receipts and 100 pending requests
|   |-- 25s timeout clears pending promise, retaining command identity
|   |-- Copy requires diagram.copy capability unless a completed result exists
|   |-- Paste allocates nodeId once; success must match nodeId and version + 1
|   `-- Both recheck reader binding after awaiting publisher result
`-- [M/O] Socket transport gates and resource limits
    |-- Copy/paste require canvasWritesEnabled; upload has a separate flag
    |-- 10s attach deadline; attach with context extends deadline to 30s
    |-- Input frames <= 8 MiB; context output <= 64 MiB
    |-- Outbound backlog > 64 KiB + context allowance closes slow reader
    `-- 15s heartbeat; socket close detaches reader or disconnects publisher

Compact anchors: projection is a reversible boundary
|-- [O/D] Per-instance retained maps
|   |-- Random 6-byte generation -> 8-character base64url token
|   |-- Revision/hash prefix identifies scope; opaque full ID gets own scope
|   |-- Handle = @generation.scope:counter; scope/counter use base 36
|   |-- Full ID -> handle and handle -> full ID maps never evict/reassign
|   `-- Default capacity: 1000000 anchors; new allocation then fails
|-- [M/C] Outgoing projection
|   |-- Tree rootIds, node IDs, parents and children become compact handles
|   |-- Grid nodes omit textRows, presentation/settings, domainNode and index
|   |-- Highlights, collapsible subtrees, jumps and edge anchors are mapped
|   `-- Non-grid nodes pass through with apiFormatVersion
|-- [C/D] Incoming resolution
|   |-- Known handle -> full ID; unknown handle shape -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE
|   |-- Non-handle input passes through for existing full-ID callers
|   `-- Domain mutations retain full IDs after decoding
|-- [D/C] Jump targets need more than reversible decoding
|   |-- New compact target is checked against target representation/diagram
|   |-- Catalog's current revision must contain the resolved content node
|   `-- Unchanged existing stale jump target may survive metadata-only update
`-- [M/O] Instance sharing is an integration requirement
    |-- Projection comment intends one backend instance shared by tools/live
    |-- Session service and live service each default to new CanvasApiProjection
    `-- Supplied sources do not show construction wiring that proves sharing

Saved diagrams and diagram-bound evidence
|-- [C/O] save_diagram serializes per canvasId/documentId
|   |-- Proposal attachment -> CHANGE_SESSION_SAVE_FORBIDDEN
|   |-- No nodeId -> browser checkpoint -> publishCheckpoint -> saved notification
|   |-- With nodeId -> snapshot and expectedVersion check -> isolated diagram
|   |   |-- Preserve ASCII, structure, source binding, evidence and mappings
|   |   |-- Rebase jumps/highlights to new content; export isolated history
|   |   `-- Save with no canvas edges through diagram service
|   `-- Notification failure returns valid save result with displayUpdated=false
|-- [D/C] diagram-agent-context read
|   |-- Snapshot identifies diagram and its document-level context binding
|   |-- No binding -> absent
|   |-- Bound fingerprint equals current source fingerprint -> ready; else stale
|   |-- Materialize backing record; optionally resolve materialized snapshot
|   `-- Status uses binding/fingerprint; payload is null if materialization absent
|-- [C/O/D] Prepare or delete diagram context
|   |-- Require expectedVersion and expectedRevisionId matching snapshot
|   |-- Prepare additionally requires storage; compile and store context
|   |-- Retain payload by [sessionId, requestId] before browser application
|   |-- Changed retry input fails; identical retry resends retained payload
|   `-- Context mutation map caps at 500 entries
`-- [M/C] Generation and saved context library
    |-- Injected generator enables edit and batch services
    |-- Direct diagram submission starts batch and waits for completion
    |-- Regular edit/create/extend starts edit or batch run for status polling
    `-- Saved context CRUD/fork/comment/lineage routes to agentContexts.library
